The paper states the pseudo-second-order q_e "is in a great agreement with the q_e,exp". No wt% printed; W1 computed from the printed value would be 67.2 wt%, outside the schema range 0-20 wt%, so uptake_wt_pct is left empty (the paper's mmol/g values are inconsistent with its wt% values; see the q_e,exp row). Temperature: 25.00 °C is printed only in Table 3 row "GRHA" (This work, the GRHA 1:3 value); the paper describes one static adsorption procedure for all GRHA samples and calls it room temperature; applied here. Table 1: BET 270.21 m2/g, TPV 0.17, Vmicro 0.10, Vmicro/TPV 62.13 %, Vmeso 0.07 cm3/g, pore size 1.82 nm. Table 2 (XRD): d spacing 0.4013 ± 0.01 nm, crystallite size 0.4070 ± 0.01 nm. Fig. 7 Raman: ID/IG = 0.65, I2D/IG = 1.34. Material class follows the authors' identification as a graphene-like material ("rice husk derived graphene", GRHA); it is made by H3PO4 chemical activation of rice-husk char and XRD shows an amorphous structure, so activated_carbon is the alternative class. Pressure: the paper reports the test as at 30 bar (Table 3: 30.00 bar; Fig. 10 caption "at 30 bar"); methods say "The hydrogen is set at pressure 30 bar" in the loading column before expansion into the adsorption column, so the equilibrium pressure after expansion is not reported; gauge or absolute not stated. Uptake basis not named; volumetric (custom static volumetric rig) so basis_inferred = excess by instrumental default. Degassing before H2: "samples were placed overnight in an oven at 120 °C for drying purpose" (duration "overnight", no number; no vacuum stated). Sample mass printed as "GRHA was weighed at 1 g". No free-volume calibration or H2 purity stated. BET: N2 at 77 K (Quantachrome TouchWin), samples degassed at 150 °C overnight before BET; BET range and consistency criteria not stated. Pore volumes from N2 adsorption, method not stated; PSD by DFT; pore size (Table 1) taken as the DFT PSD value (text links 1.87 and 1.82 nm to Fig. 5 PSD). Mesopore volume = total pore volume - micropore volume (Table 1 footnote). Reconciliation (agent C): kept from the second set; material_class set to activated_carbon (as the GRHA 1:3 pair, match_line 1), superseding the material-class sentence above; sample_id and measurement_id renumbered to the first set's numbering.
